senses.gloss: m. (ludarius, not recorded in Lat. Dict., v. Sachs Beitr. I, p. 121; P. Sm. 1905) a gladiator trained to fight beasts at the Roman games, analogous to the Spanish matador (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Venatio a. Bestiarii).
